decisions.title: Approve the mock-only implementation phase (F5-04/M1)
decisions.authorizes: app code changes strictly per this package: 26 new files (route, page, 15 lib modules, 9 test files) plus synced scenario copies, 3 low-risk touch points, on feature branch feature/qa-research-mock-only, following the 13-step sequence (doc 15); mock backend only
decisions.does_not_authorize: live database binding, preview or production contact, embeddings, display-gate changes, migration/loader/ingestion/PDF changes, legacy route or chat page changes, new dependencies
decisions.rollback: delete one directory plus revert three one-line-scale edits

decisions.title: Ratify the M1 policy defaults
items: verified_resolved citations demote in M1 (no mid-answer span fetch); F5-05 revisits
QA-page participant check ships as a hook, allow-all-authenticated default in M1 (synthetic data), tightened before any live target
QA_RESEARCH_ENABLED defaults false; dev enablement at owner discretion

decisions.title: Branch preference
decisions.note: identical sequence either way; state a preference only to override the default
